subject: sentences
title: Opposites and strong words
about: Opposites (hot and cold) and shades of meaning (big, huge; walk, tiptoe; talk, whisper). NC L.1.5c asks first graders to tell apart verbs that differ in manner and adjectives that differ in intensity.
tip: Act the strong word out together: tiptoe across the room, whisper the answer, make yourself huge.

cards.q: What is the opposite of hot?
cards.note: Hot and cold are opposites. Warm is only a little hot.

cards.q: What is the opposite of big?
cards.note: Big and small are opposites. Tall and wide tell about size too, but they are not the opposite of big.

cards.q: What is the opposite of up?
cards.note: Up and down are opposites. A ball goes up, then it comes down.

cards.q: What is the opposite of fast?
cards.note: Fast and slow are opposites. Quick means the same as fast.

cards.q: What is the opposite of wet?
cards.note: Wet and dry are opposites. Damp means a little wet.

cards.q: What is the opposite of happy?
cards.note: Happy and sad are opposites. Glad means the same as happy.

cards.q: What is the opposite of day?
cards.note: Day and night are opposites. Morning and noon are parts of the day.

cards.q: What is the opposite of in?
cards.note: In and out are opposites. You go in the box, then out of the box.
Huge is a bigger word than big. An elephant is huge.
Tiny is a smaller word than small. An ant is tiny.
Freezing is colder than cold. Cool is only a little cold.
Soaked is wetter than wet. Damp is only a little wet.

cards.q: Which word means to walk very quietly?
cards.note: Tiptoe, walk and stomp are all ways to move your feet. Tiptoe is the quiet one.

cards.q: Which word means to look at something for a long time?
cards.note: Peek is a quick look; stare is a long look.

cards.q: Which word means to talk very quietly?
cards.note: Whisper, talk and shout are all ways to use your voice. Whisper is the quiet one.

cards.q: Which word means to run as fast as you can?
cards.note: Crawl, walk, run and dash are all ways to move. Dash is the fastest.
